description: This file defines a static class 'OptionsOverrides' that provides extension methods for retrieving overridable options, specifically for 'ClusterOptions', within the Orleans framework. It facilitates overriding configuration options using named options, with fallback to default values.

classes.name: OptionsOverrides
classes.description: Provides static extension methods for retrieving overridable options, particularly for 'ClusterOptions', within the Orleans configuration system.

methods.name: GetProviderClusterOptions
methods.description: Retrieves 'ClusterOptions' for a specific provider, allowing for overrides on a per-provider basis.

methods.name: GetOverridableOption
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve an option that can be overridden by a named service, with fallback to default options.
